description: This file defines the AttendanceReportSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering attendance reports. It extends date range parameters and includes filtering options by employee numbers, job title, subunit, and employment status. It uses traits to manage subunit ID chains and enforces sort field constraints.

classes.name: AttendanceReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters used in attendance report queries, including date range, employee numbers, job title, subunit, and employment status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field set to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Returns the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used as filter.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.
